comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers vs clear a fragile egg before placing a pot on a trivet.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled screen pouring and agitation vs inspect a placement surface, relocate a fragile obstruction, and set down a heavy object safely.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% media recovered, washers retained, no loss/damage, screen released vs egg safely supported, pot fully on trivet, no harmful contact, both released and still.
comparison.reason: Safe obstruction clearing and placement do not exercise selective granular separation.
